description: The Phase 0 allow-list of verbs and programs (wave 5 Q9), with one valid example each. v2 changes only the wording of sleep and rest: a shelter other than a bed counts for rest. The examples are checked against the output validator by a test. Immutable once used: a change is a new vN file.

say.summary: Speak aloud to anyone within earshot (at most 256 characters). A thought may carry say on its own or together with actions and an intent.

example.say: Hello, I am heading to the hills.

verbs.summary: Walk to a position or up to a person.

fields.target: a position {x,y,z} or a person's name

verbs.summary: Dig the nearest blocks of one kind and pick up what they drop.
Make an item you have unlocked the recipe for, from what you carry.

fields.at: a position {x,y,z} or the word feet

verbs.summary: Eat the best food you carry.
Go to bed and sleep. Works at night near a bed you have placed. With no bed, rest by waiting in a sealed shelter (the rest routine).
Open the chest at a position.
Put items from your inventory into the chest at a position.
Take items out of the chest at a position.
Fight a nearby creature or person.

fields.target: a name or entity type such as zombie

verbs.summary: Stand still and let time pass.
Get free when you are stuck or cannot find a way down: the body digs down or steps down one block at a time. Needs no items.

programs.summary: Walk to a position or up to a person, as long as it takes (up to three tries).

arguments.target: a position {x,y,z} or a person's name

programs.summary: Collect a number of one item by mining blocks, until you hold that many.

arguments.block: block name to mine, such as stone
arguments.count: how many you want to hold, 1 to 2304
arguments.item: optional: the item that drops, when it differs from the block
arguments.radius: optional: how far to look, 1 to 64

programs.summary: Craft an item until you hold that many.

arguments.count: how many you want to hold, 1 to 576

programs.summary: Recover health by sleeping in a bed, or by waiting quietly in a sealed shelter: a hut, a house, or a hole in the ground sealed above and around you.

arguments.until_health: optional: stop at this health, 1 to 20 (default 20)
arguments.max_waits: optional: give up after this many waits, 1 to 120 (default 30)

programs.summary: Run away from nearby hostile creatures.

arguments.distance: optional: how far to run per leg, 8 to 64 (default 24)

wake_on.summary: Conditions that interrupt an intent so you can think again. Keep the list short.
